citation: Barone MM, Moizio M, Choudhary R, D'Errico C, Trkulja V, Torta L, Davino S, Matic S. Development of a Field-Deployable Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Assay for the Rapid Detection of Erysiphe corylacearum in Hazelnut.
what_it_anchors: Time to positive for 3 templates x 3 isothermal temperatures and 3 templates x a ten-fold mass dilution, with 10^-6 printed ND; the source of inst/extdata/readout_lamp_erysiphe2026.csv
claim: Real-time SYTO LAMP at 60 C detects both hazelnut isolates down to the 10^-5 dilution of a 20 ng/uL extract (200 fg stated) with Tp 47.43 +/- 1.26 and 49.87 +/- 0.18 min, and is not detected at 10^-6 within the 60-min run; at 63 and 65 C Tp for the same three templates rises to 32-40 and 34-37 min
access_detail: open access; fulltext.xml read; Tables 2 and 3 parsed from the raw table-wrap bodies. Reaction: 12.5 uL, 6.25 uL 2x SuperScript IV RT-LAMP master mix, 1.5 uL DNA (35 ng), Rotor-Gene Q, readings every 15 s, 60 min, 2 technical replicates. NOT printed: copies or genome equivalents per reaction, Mg2+, and the SD's n is stated in Methods (2) not in the table. Table 2 is non-monotone at 63->65 C for 8.2_PdIT (37 then 35 min).

citation: Nalefski EA, Hedley S, Rajaraman K, Kooistra RM, Parikh I, Sinan S, Finklestein IJ, Madan D. Unleashing high trans-substrate cleavage kinetics of Cas12a for nucleic acid diagnostics.
what_it_anchors: Rejected CRISPR-Dx kinetics candidate: the best source found for Cas12a per-crRNA activation and trans-cleavage parameters, but none of the numbers is in the article body
claim: LODs from 60-minute endpoints reach 110-530 fM with C10 and 190-680 fM with T5 trans-substrate across three RNPs; k_ss spans 0.58-5.3 per s and 1.3-3.33e8 per M per s over 23 RNPs
access_detail: open access full text read, but every per-RNP value (Tables S2, S5, S6, S9-S17 and Figs S1-S13) sits in the supplementary PDF, which PMC serves behind a cloudpmc proof-of-work interstitial and OUP serves 403; Europe PMC supplementaryFiles returns an HTML error page. Article-body numbers are aggregates only, so no condition->outcome table could be built. Not used as a dataset.
